title: Control: array of records with a required nested record in each element
rationale: The good-input drill for the array-of-records machinery and the baseline the two array DEFECT fixtures are measured against. Two elements rather than one, so per-index alignment is actually tested - a single-element array would pass even if indexing were entirely broken.
catchesBugClass: Regression in column-wise array transposition and per-index realignment. Because the two elements differ in every field, any index confusion or last-element-repeat yields a visibly wrong result.
cannotCatch: Everything here is present and non-null, which is exactly the condition under which this code works. It cannot catch the two null-driven failures, nor the last-element-repeat in nested record reconstruction.

predicted.detail: There is no bare array key, so the array node is not a leaf and the column-wise path is taken; elements come back in order.
